pages.title: G4. Questions (a)-(c)
paragraphs: (a) Which check caught most Batch B problems, and which problem was missed? PENDING real verification report. The owned fixture set plants exact/near duplicates, corrupt/truncated/missing/garbled input, a newer version and valid injected content. Do not rank checks from planted counts or fake-model unit results. Moez must cite actual per-check outcomes and an actual missed condition.

(b) Where did module metrics look good while component/end-to-end did not? PENDING paired real suite results. Preserve both seeded runs, noise deltas and negative outcomes. If no such divergence occurs, say so and cite the actual result files; do not manufacture a failure narrative.

(c) Archive or delete old versions, and what breaks if deleted? Design fact: previously accepted superseded versions are archived; default retrieval excludes superseded metadata while A2 explicit historical queries remain compatible. Pins restore a verified version using cached vectors. Deletions reconcile zero rows in the published generation; retired snapshots remain recovery/in-flight history.

Deleting all historical objects or retired snapshots prematurely would remove rollback bytes/vectors and could break in-flight evidence or historical replay. This is the design rationale in ADR0005, not a claim that the live rollback demonstration passed. CO-05/06 interpretation still needs partner/instructor review.

pages.title: G4. Questions (d)-(f)
paragraphs: (d) Which suite metric is least trusted? Provisional engineering assessment: LLM-judge faithfulness depends on the chosen model/prompt and may disagree with humans. This is not a measured ranking. Moez must independently label at least8 answers before reading judge outputs, report agreement/disagreement and revise this answer using actual findings.

(e) Which paper idea was hardest, and what changed? Verified implementation trade-off: safe incremental publication retains immutable snapshots and copies unchanged vectors physically, while embedding only changed content. This protects a working index through failures but costs storage; automatic GC was not added. Do not claim personal hours or a paper-specific hardest experience until both members review the exact paper and actual run evidence.

(f) Which Kubernetes object carries which responsibility? API Deployment serves read-only queries; Chroma StatefulSet/PVC stores vectors; Redis Deployment/PVC caches guarded responses; ingestion Job is the writer; CronJob schedules it; shared lock PVC serializes manual/scheduled/rollback writers. Data-lake and trace PVCs persist artifacts. Eval Job writes results and fails when gate fails; gate ConfigMap changes thresholds without rebuilding. Candidate Deployment/Service stages a separate collection; rolling update and release.py undo synchronize live reader and future writer.
Manifest presence and fake kubectl tests are implementation evidence. F3/F4/F5 still require actual rollout/undo traces, persistent-volume checks and measured resource margins.
